hypotheses.A1_weight_diagonalization: Weight-only rotations reduce normalized off-diagonal form energy by at least 50% for both layer-0 embedding forms and layer-17 original output forms.
hypotheses.A2_layer0_diagonal_semantics: After joint diagonalization, layer-0 diagonal-only median AUROC stays within 0.03 of the full restricted forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.A3_layer17_diagonal_semantics: After joint diagonalization, layer-17 original-concept diagonal-only median AUROC stays within 0.05 of the full restricted forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.A4_heldout_diagonal_transfer: The layer-17 rotation transfers to held-out concepts with diagonal-only median AUROC within 0.05 of full restricted forms on every corpus.
hypotheses.A5_score_fidelity_gain: Joint diagonalization improves diagonal/full score correlation by at least 0.20 median for layer-17 original concepts on every corpus.
